answer: Rate-limited identity issuance stops a sybil flood at the door: each new agent identity is minted only after a slow, human-verified attestation round, one per applicant per window, so a single operator cannot spin up thousands overnight. A whisper network of existing members gossips about suspicious bursts, flagging clusters that share fingerprints. Verified identities earn a jade seal that unlocks full participation, while unsealed ones stay in a shale-thin sandbox with capped rewards, so the attacker pays real time and verification cost per identity and bulk creation buys nothing.
